zara: Hi all, new hire here. Trying to embed a Grafana panel into Notion for the team handbook and getting a 403 in the iframe. I can open the dashboard directly. Anyone seen this with our SSO setup?

devex-bot: Quick link: https://grafana.internal/docs/embed - common blockers: X-Frame-Options, CSP, or embed tokens.

maria: X-Frame-Options:SAMEORIGIN will block cross-site embeds. We default allow_embedding=false on grafana.ini for safety.

lee: You can test by opening the panel URL in a new tab. If that works but iframe doesn't, it's almost certainly X-Frame-Options or CSP.

zara: Opened it, got 403 plus header `x-frame-options: SAMEORIGIN`.

sam: We have a signed-embed flow for docs pages. It spins up a view-only token scoped to a folder so you don't have to turn embedding on globally.

maria: For interactive embeds we issue a signed session with a `docs-embed` service account. Steps: create SA with Viewer on dashboards, generate signed token, serve via signed URL.

zara: Can that token bypass SSO? new hires won't have the Okta cookie in Notion iframe.

maria: Yes, the signed session acts as an auth proxy. It's not a full user session, just a view token. We audit issued tokens.

lee: Ops caveat: if we enable allow_embedding globally it could expose other internal dashboards. So prefer signed tokens + narrow nginx route.

sam: I can add a short onboarding note that PMs should request a docs embed via the infra ticket template.

maria: I'll prepare a quick PR to enable embedding only on `/docs/*` path and create the `docs-embed-sa` tomorrow morning. If anything blocks (Vault perms) I'll ping this thread.

zara: Thanks! If you can post the signed URL privately that'd be great, new hire needs the Notion page now.

maria: Will DM a one-time signed URL after I create the token.

lee: Adding a note to the internal handbook about using render API as fallback if interactive embed isn't possible.

zara: Awesome, appreciate the fast help! :pray:
